title: eval-harness: integrate prompt-regression metrics into CI gating and add improved CI hook
author: Asha Patel
description: Motivation: prevent silent prompt-set regressions from reaching production by surfacing eval metrics in CI and adding a lightweight CI hook that computes regression deltas against baseline prompt-sets. This PR adds a new eval-metrics CI pipeline, a reusable prompt-regression hook for our evaluation harness, and a small test suite to validate gating behavior. The implementation computes a small set of core metrics (exact-match, F1, BLEU-lite, answer-stability) and compares to the baseline stored in S3. If any configured metric regresses beyond the threshold for a route, the pipeline marks the PR as failed and posts a summary to the PR. Summary of changes and rollout: 1) ci/pipelines/eval-metrics.yml - new pipeline that runs nightly and on PRs when eval labels are present. 2) eval-harness/ci/hooks/prompt_regression_hook.py - main hook that downloads baselines, runs the eval runner with the PR candidate model/changes, computes deltas and formats a PR summary. 3) tests/eval/test_regression_gate.py - unit and integration tests mocking S3 baselines and small eval artifacts. 4) docs/eval-harness/ci.md - documentation for adding gating to a repo. 5) small SDK helper in redwood-sdk-python/examples/eval_gating.py used in the pipeline. Notes on safety and performance: the hook samples the prompt-set (configurable, default 500 examples) and runs in a lightweight mode to limit runtime; full evals remain nightly. CI failure modes are non-blocking by default for non-critical branches and can be promoted to required by repo owners via CODEOWNERS. Testing: local unit tests and the CI pipeline were exercised; the first integration run exposed a flaky metric aggregation (off-by-one in sample counting) which was fixed in commit 3. Related work: linked to Linear ENG-3241 (prompt regression gating) and ENG-3305 (eval metrics integration).
commits: Initial hook and pipeline definition (eval-metrics.yml + prompt_regression_hook.py)
Add unit tests and mocks for S3 baselines
Fix sample counting bug in metrics aggregation (handle empty buckets)
Add docs and quickstart example for repo owners
Address review comments: robustness and logging improvements
review_comments: Diego Martinez: Can we make the baseline S3 path configurable per-repo rather than hardcoding the global bucket? Author: added per-repo override and documented behavior.
Lena Zhou: The default sample size should be conservative to keep runtime low in PRs. Author: reduced default to 500 and added an env var to override in pipelines.
Ethan Cole: Please add more robust logging around metric computation and edge cases when baselines are missing. Author: added guarded code paths and explicit PR comment when baseline not found.
release_notes: Add CI integration to compute prompt-regression metrics on PRs and nightly runs. Includes a reusable eval-harness hook, pipeline config, tests, and docs. Enables early detection of prompt-set regressions and posts a short summary to the PR.
